entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Guyana.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de vencimiento al menos 6 meses posterior a tu llegada a Guyana.
entry.quote: To enter Guyana, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: You will not be able to enter Guyana without a valid travel document or with a passport reported lost or stolen.
entry.es: No podrás entrar a Guyana sin un documento de viaje válido ni con un pasaporte reportado como perdido o robado.
entry.quote: You will not be able to enter Guyana if you do not have a valid travel document or try to use a passport that has been reported lost or stolen.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you come from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país catalogado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: You must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty, as there are strict rules on goods taken in or out.
entry.es: Debes declarar todo lo que pueda estar prohibido o sujeto a impuestos o aranceles, pues hay normas estrictas sobre las mercancías que entran o salen.
entry.quote: There are strict rules about goods you can take into or out of Guyana. You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

safety.en: Crime levels are significant and police capacity is low, with petty crime common and violent crime a continuing risk.
safety.es: Los niveles de delincuencia son significativos y la capacidad policial es baja; el delito menor es común y el violento sigue siendo un riesgo.
safety.quote: Crime levels are significant, and police capacity is low. Petty crime, including pickpocketing and bag snatching, is common, and violent crime continues to be a risk.

safety.en: Attacks and muggings have occurred in broad daylight but are more common at night, and have involved knives or firearms.
safety.es: Han ocurrido ataques y atracos a plena luz del día, pero son más comunes de noche, e incluyeron cuchillos o armas de fuego.
safety.quote: Attacks and muggings have occurred in broad daylight but are more common at night, and have included the use of knives or firearms.

safety.en: There have been incidents of gangs following cars from Cheddi Jagan International Airport and attacking victims on arrival at their destination.
safety.es: Ha habido casos de bandas que siguen a coches desde el aeropuerto internacional Cheddi Jagan y atacan a las víctimas al llegar a su destino.
safety.quote: There have been incidents of gangs following cars from Cheddi Jagan International Airport and then attacking their victims when they reach their destination.

safety.en: Venezuela disputes the legitimacy of its border with Guyana, and the security situation along the border remains tense.
safety.es: Venezuela disputa la legitimidad de su frontera con Guyana y la situación de seguridad en la frontera sigue tensa.
safety.quote: Venezuela disputes the legitimacy of its border with Guyana. Political tensions remain and the security situation along the border remains tense.

safety.en: Private taxis can be targeted by robbers but are the safest way for visitors to get around Georgetown.
safety.es: Los taxis privados pueden ser objetivo de ladrones, pero son la forma más segura de moverse por Georgetown para los visitantes.
safety.quote: Although private taxis can be targeted by robbers, they are the safest way for visitors to get around Georgetown.

safety.en: Driving in Guyana can be dangerous because of reckless drivers, frequent hazards, poor street lighting and poor road conditions.
safety.es: Conducir en Guyana puede ser peligroso por conductores temerarios, peligros frecuentes, mala iluminación y malas condiciones de las vías.
safety.quote: Driving in Guyana can be dangerous because of reckless drivers, frequent hazards, poor street lighting, and poor road conditions.

health.en: Medical facilities are very limited in Guyana, even in Georgetown.
health.es: Las instalaciones médicas en Guyana son muy limitadas, incluso en Georgetown.
health.quote: Medical facilities are very limited, even in Georgetown.

health.en: Standards of medical practice are low, and an evacuation should be arranged for any serious or invasive treatment if possible.
health.es: El nivel de la práctica médica es bajo y, de ser posible, se debe organizar una evacuación para cualquier tratamiento grave o invasivo.
health.quote: Standards of medical practice are low and you should arrange an evacuation for any serious or invasive treatment if possible.

health.en: Adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds are needed to cover medical treatment abroad and repatriation.
health.es: Se necesita un seguro de salud de viaje adecuado y fondos accesibles para cubrir el tratamiento médico en el extranjero y la repatriación.
health.quote: Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover the cost of any medical treatment abroad and repatriation.

health.en: Wikivoyage advises not to drink the tap water, and bottled water is readily available.
health.es: Wikivoyage aconseja no beber agua del grifo, y el agua embotellada se consigue fácilmente.
health.quote: Do not drink the tap water, unless you want to spend a great part of your vacation on the toilet. Bottled water is readily available in a variety of brands.

health.en: Malaria is described as widespread throughout most of the country, and anti-malarial medication is suggested.
health.es: Se describe la malaria como extendida por la mayor parte del país y se sugiere tomar medicación antipalúdica.
health.quote: it is a good idea to receive anti-malarial medications from your health care provider, as malaria is widespread throughout most of the country.

health.en: Yellow fever is endemic in the area, and you can catch it even in cities.
health.es: La fiebre amarilla es endémica en la zona y se puede contraer incluso en las ciudades.
health.quote: Yellow fever is endemic to this area; monkeys are a reservoir, but you can catch it even in cities.

help.en: The emergency numbers in Guyana are 913 for ambulance, 912 for fire and 911 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Guyana son 913 (ambulancia), 912 (bomberos) y 911 (policía).

getting_in.en: There are daily international flights into Cheddi Jagan International Airport, about 40 km south of Georgetown.
getting_in.es: Hay vuelos internacionales diarios al aeropuerto internacional Cheddi Jagan, a unos 40 km al sur de Georgetown.
getting_in.quote: There are daily international flights into Cheddi Jagan International Airport about 40 km south of Georgetown.

getting_in.en: Entering Guyana from Suriname requires a boat, as no bridge crosses the Courantyne River.
getting_in.es: Para entrar a Guyana desde Surinam hay que tomar un barco, pues no hay puente sobre el río Courantyne.
getting_in.quote: All entry to Guyana from Suriname requires getting on a boat

getting_in.en: The Suriname ferry accepts only US or Suriname dollars in cash, and the nearest ATM is a 40-minute drive away.
getting_in.es: El ferri desde Surinam solo acepta efectivo en dólares estadounidenses o surinameses, y el cajero más cercano está a 40 minutos en coche.
getting_in.quote: they only accept cold, hard US or Suriname dollars, and the nearest ATM is a 40-minute drive away in Nieuw Nickerie.

getting_in.en: There are no road links between Venezuela and Guyana.
getting_in.es: No hay conexiones por carretera entre Venezuela y Guyana.
getting_in.quote: There are no road links between Venezuela and Guyana.

getting_in.en: Guyana has road access to Suriname via a river-crossing ferry and to Brazil to the south.
getting_in.es: Guyana tiene acceso por carretera a Surinam (con un ferri en el río) y a Brasil al sur.
getting_in.quote: Guyana has road access to Suriname to the east (via river-crossing ferry) and Brazil to the south.

getting_in.en: The bus ride from Lethem on the Brazilian border to Georgetown takes at least 10 hours.
getting_in.es: El viaje en autobús de Lethem, en la frontera con Brasil, a Georgetown dura al menos 10 horas.
getting_in.quote: The bus ride from Lethem, at the Brazilian border, to Georgetown takes at least 10 hours through rainforest and southern savannah.

getting_around.en: Buses in Guyana means minibuses, which travel throughout the country and are the cheapest way to travel.
getting_around.es: Los autobuses en Guyana son minibuses, que recorren todo el país y son la forma más barata de viajar.
getting_around.quote: When people in Guyana refer to buses, they mean minibuses. Minibuses travel throughout Guyana and are the cheapest way to travel.

getting_around.en: Minibus fares range from G$60 to G$1,000 depending on the length of the journey.
getting_around.es: Las tarifas de minibús van de G$60 a G$1.000 según la duración del viaje.
getting_around.quote: Minibus fares range from G$60-1,000 depending on the length of the journey.

getting_around.en: Large rivers separate many areas, which can be crossed by river taxi.
getting_around.es: Grandes ríos separan muchas zonas, que se pueden cruzar en taxi fluvial.
getting_around.quote: Many parts of Guyana are separated by large rivers. These areas can be traversed by way of river taxi.

getting_around.en: Taxis are a good way to get around Georgetown, with most fares around G$400 and never more than G$500 within the city.
getting_around.es: Los taxis son una buena forma de moverse por Georgetown, con la mayoría de tarifas en torno a G$400 y nunca más de G$500 dentro de la ciudad.
getting_around.quote: Taxis are a good way to get around in Georgetown. Fares should never be more than G$500 for travel within the city and most fares should be around G$400.

getting_around.en: There are set taxi prices for some destinations, for example G$5,000 from the airport to town.
getting_around.es: Hay precios fijos de taxi para algunos destinos, por ejemplo G$5.000 del aeropuerto a la ciudad.
getting_around.quote: There are set prices for taxis for different destinations, e.g. from the airport to town costs G$5,000

money.en: The local currency is the Guyanese dollar (GYD), denoted $ or G$.
money.es: La moneda local es el dólar guyanés (GYD), representado con $ o G$.
money.quote: The local currency is the Guyanese dollar, denoted $ or G$ (ISO international currency code: GYD).

money.en: Scotiabank and Republic Bank take MasterCards at their ATMs.
money.es: Scotiabank y Republic Bank aceptan MasterCard en sus cajeros automáticos.
money.quote: Scotiabank and Republic bank take MasterCards at their ATMs.

money.en: The Guyanese dollar is nearly impossible to get rid of outside Guyana and neighbouring countries.
money.es: Es casi imposible deshacerse del dólar guyanés fuera de Guyana y los países vecinos.
money.quote: The currency is freely convertible but nearly impossible to get rid of outside of Guyana, the neighbouring countries and one exchange bureau in London Gatwick airport.

money.en: When exchanging money or buying on the street, go inside the exchange or shop, or use ATMs inside banks or shopping centres.
money.es: Al cambiar dinero o comprar en la calle, entra a la casa de cambio o tienda, o usa cajeros dentro de bancos o centros comerciales.
money.quote: Take care when exchanging money or buying goods on the street. Go inside the money exchange or shop, or use ATMs inside banks or shopping centres.

money.en: The cost of living is relatively very high because most daily items are imported.
money.es: El costo de vida es relativamente muy alto porque la mayoría de los artículos de uso diario son importados.
money.quote: The cost of living in Guyana is relatively very high, because most of the items used in daily life are imported with high transportation costs involved.

etiquette.en: Guyanese people do not wear shoes in their homes and expect visitors to do the same.
etiquette.es: Los guyaneses no usan zapatos dentro de casa y esperan que los visitantes hagan lo mismo.
etiquette.quote: Guyanese people do not wear shoes in their homes and expect visitors to do the same.

etiquette.en: Ethnic relations, politics and socio-economic issues should be discussed with much tact and patience.
etiquette.es: Las relaciones étnicas, la política y los temas socioeconómicos deben tratarse con mucho tacto y paciencia.
etiquette.quote: Discussions of the current affairs of ethnic relations between the two major races, politics and the socio-economic issues in the country ought to be undertaken with much tact and much patience.
